newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche MG changes London roles - report.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche MG changes London roles - report.

text.p: Investment bank Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will make Jonathan Asquith chief executive of its London-based subsidiary Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Group, the Daily Telegraph reported on Wednesday.

The newspaper said Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Group included most European corporate finance operations outside Germany, Morgan Grenfell Asset Management and the bank's equities business in Britain, south east Asia, South Africa and Scandinavia.
Asquith would replace Michael Dobson, who takes on the role of chairman and remains chief executive of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the Daily Telegraph said.
The newspaper said "insiders" believed Asquith's new role would be larger than the title suggested and that he might eventually assume control of the UK region.
A spokesman for the bank in London said it had no comment.
